name: Shaddam IV
text:
You start the game with a [Spice Token].
[Action [Arrow]:] Play a [{Sardaukar}] card from your hand, ignoring its additional costs.

backArt.src: Shaddam IV - Emperor of the Known Universe (unit) (art).webp

backText:
Once each round, when you play a [{Sardaukar}] card, you may ignore its additional costs.
[When Deployed:] You may play a [{Sardaukar}] unit from your hand or discard pile for free.
Other friendly [{Sardaukar}] units gain [Sentinel].
subtitle: Padishah Emperor
